introduction.title: Arrange rows for queries across several dimensions
paragraphs: Lindel maps coordinates to one integer using a Hilbert or Morton space-filling curve. Sorting by that integer places nearby points close together in the stored row order.

Use it when writing Parquet or loading tables for queries that filter several dimensions, such as location and time. A curve ordering makes row-group statistics more selective, so readers skip more data. Lindel also quantizes latitude/longitude and other bounded values onto a grid, accepts dates, timestamps and decimals as coordinates, decodes keys by type, and turns a box into key ranges for key-only stores.
